purpose: Precommitted stratum quotas for the Go real-source audit, set from population counts only (no labels, no Girder) per methodology.md.
continuation: If fewer than 100 actual calls after the first 140, draw the next 40 from the same seeded order (same strata proportions) and repeat, per methodology.md.
note: Builtins are not calls; their 7-site quota is a not-a-call control. bare_cross_file population is only 107, so its 40 draws are the main exercise of the policy under test.
selection_rule: Initial draw: the first quota[k] candidates of each stratum k in `tools.go_audit_sites --emit --seed <seed>` order. Continuation round r: the next continuation_rounds_of_40[k] candidates of each stratum after all earlier rounds. A stratum that runs out sends its shortfall to bare_cross_file, then bare_other, then selector, in that order. Mechanical form: `tools.go_audit_sites --root DIR --select quotas.json --round N`.
site_match_rule: A site matches a Girder claim when claim.site.end_byte == the site's call_end_byte (exact; each call node ends at its own closing parenthesis, so the end byte is unique per call).
